messages:
jin: FYI I opened a small PR to tighten the "supported regions" matrix and add a brief "how to migrate" note for Dedicated customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/857

sara: Thanks. Can you add one line explaining what "data residency" means here (i.e., customer-configured processing/storage locality; default global routing unless residency explicitly set)? Legal wants that clarified.

mike: Added an SDK snippet demonstrating a cloud region (for routing) and a separate residency enum (for storage/processing). Left a short inline comment in the snippet to avoid confusion.

ashley: Quick legal nudge: avoid absolute terms like "guarantee". Suggest: "We process and store customer data within the selected region(s) under contractual terms." Also add a link to our KMS/HSM integration docs: https://internal.redwood/security/kms-integration

jin: Good call. I'll update the paragraph and append the KMS link. Also planning a one-paragraph migration checklist for Dedicated: env var + CLI flag and the default behaviour for older agents.

sara: Migration checklist should be explicit: set RW_REGION or use `redwood deploy --region`. Note that older clients without region flags will continue to route to the global namespace until they opt in.

mike: Here's the JS block I pushed to the PR (kept minimal):

```js
// Node SDK: routing vs residency example
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  region: "eu-west-1",      // cloud region for routing (e.g. eu-west-1)
  dataResidency: "eu"     // optional: residency preference ("eu" | "us" | "apac")
});
const resp = await client.generate({ model: "redwood-1" });
```

sara: Could you also add a curl example for infra folks? We should cover both SDK and CLI patterns.

mike: Added curl + CLI snippet in the PR. CLI example shows `redwood deploy --region eu-west-1` and export RW_REGION in env.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/857  labels: [docs] [legal-review] [region-updates]

ashley: I reviewed copy. Replace "we guarantee" with the suggested language and add the KMS link. Also recommend a short footnote clarifying that cross-region replication is opt-in and controlled via account settings.

jin: Done  updated the sentence, added KMS link and a footnote about replication opt-in. I also corrected the APAC row — changed region codes to ap-southeast-1 (SG) and ap-northeast-1 (JP); previously had ap-south-1 by mistake.

sara: Nice catch. One last style thing: for SDK param names, do we stick with `region` + `dataResidency` or do we rename to `regionCode`? I prefer keeping `region` for cloud region and a short enum for residency to keep parity with server-side routing config.

mike: Agreed. Kept `region` + `dataResidency` and added inline comments in both SDK and curl snippets to make intent explicit.

sara: LGTM from product side :thumbsup: Once legal gives final sign-off, I'll merge and backport to the v1.2 branch.

docs-bot: PR #857 merged into main by sara  changelog auto-generated: "docs: clarify supported regions, add data residency notes and migration checklist"

jin: Thanks everyone. I'll ping Console so they can update the region selector help copy with the new text.
